# gate-news-briefing-staging v1.0.1 Changelog

- Updates runtime rules references to new file paths in SKILL.md.
- Removes legacy documentation and scenario files (CHANGELOG.md, README.md, and references/scenarios.md).
- Adds new references for runtime rule documentation (gate-runtime-rules.md, info-news-runtime-rules.md).
- Minor workflow text clean-up; skill logic and structure remain unchanged.

Initial release of gate-news-briefing skill for crypto industry news summaries.

- Provides concise crypto news briefings based on user requests for recent headlines or updates.
- Aggregates major events, trending news, and social sentiment by calling three Gate-News MCP tools in parallel.
- Automatically routes queries involving other analysis dimensions (e.g., coin analysis, risk check) to gate-info-research.
- Supports both general and coin-specific news modes with distinct report templates.
- Applies clear de-duplication, ranking, and categorization rules to deliver structured summaries.
